# Implementation of the Deforestation Regulation

The Regulation on deforestation-free products (EU) 2023/1115 applies from 30 December 2025 for large and medium operators and from 30 June 2026 for micro and small enterprises.
This page collects the Guidance Document, the FAQ, the country benchmarking list and access to the EUDR Information System where due diligence statements are submitted.
